name: laravel-truss
description: A live database structure viewer for Laravel that renders your schema as a scrollable, zoomable ER diagram. Structure only, never data.

paragraphs: Laravel Truss is a live database structure viewer. It scans your live schema and renders it as a scrollable, zoomable ER diagram right inside your app, so you can see how the tables actually connect without opening a DB client. It reads structure only (tables, columns, keys, indexes); row data is never queried or exposed.

Try the live demo to pan, zoom, focus, and export a sample schema in your browser, no install needed, then build a palette in the theme builder and copy the config. See what has shipped and what is next on the roadmap.
Stay updated: click Watch > Custom > Releases to hear about new features, follow along in Discussions, or join the Discord.
features: Live ER diagram of your database, rendered with Mermaid.
Focus mode: a table and its foreign-key neighbours, centred and highlighted. The picker is searchable, matching anywhere in the table name, so it stays usable on a schema with hundreds of tables.
Filter by table name, and toggle native types against Laravel-style labels.
Map-style pan and zoom, with auto-fit and a Fit button.

Export the diagram as PNG or SVG, or its structure as JSON, CSV, a Markdown data dictionary, DBML, or a token-trimmed llm format, from the browser or, for CI and tooling, from the command line with php artisan…
